segments.text: ALmightie God, which madeſt thy bleſſed ſonne to be circumciſed and obedyente to the lawe for manne: graunte vs the true circumciſion of thy ſpirite, that our heartes and all our members being mortifyed from all worldly and carnall luſtes, may in all thinges obey thy bleſſed wil, through the ſame thy ſonne Ieſus Chriſt our Lorde.
